verdict.rationale: Convex is a managed reactive database with no-setup provisioning (npm create convex@latest), automatic table creation, and client/server SDKs across React, Next.js, Remix, Vue, Svelte, React Native etc., plus HTTP endpoints for server-side access; ACID transactions and real-time sync are documented, and community/HN commentary corroborates the reactivity model internals. missing for 10: no independent hands-on benchmark of read/write latency or large-scale production usage report beyond docs and one HN thread.
